source.condition: Historical w2lvar standing local MN extraction; working copy, not the later selected Hunt controller.
source.units: Source C numeric on seconds clock converted to nF for SNS millisecond clock: C_nF=1000*C_numeric.

interface.inputs: Ia/II/Ib and direct MN currents; omitted PF/RG/other-muscle boundary drives are supplied externally.

physical_maps.gating: Exact gIa/gII/gIb phase/drive/gamma factors are retained in the hashed runner.py and AFF/MOD/G dictionaries. No GRF is silently substituted for source tendon Ib.

actuation.policy: All92 MNs and afferent arcs remain; runner zeros force parameters of six listed routes. This export is biological, not the86-route virtual BPA replacement.
actuation.motor_conversion: clip(MN voltage / E_HI,0,1); E_HI=5.0 mV; native activation and contraction dynamics follow.
actuation.input_policy: --reflex-stand: II setpoint at initial standing length; solved per-muscle POST_ bias with saved scale; supraspinal BAL surrogate inputs zero; posture_to_mn=0.
actuation.apparatus: Existing pelvis springs; vertical stiffness0.01, damping multiplier4.2. Not harness-free.
actuation.frame: Legacy converted Gait z-up; distinct from y-up CAD.
